vstar_qwen_regression.purpose: declared Phase-1 regression and Phase-2 calibration/evaluation set
vstar_qwen_regression.selection_rule: existing 30-topic Phase-1 development set; retained without reselection

vstar_internvl_spatial_holdout.purpose: first Phase-1 relative-position transfer set; opened once v2 was frozen, then used only for v3 failure diagnosis
vstar_internvl_spatial_holdout.selection_rule: 20 lowest sha256('phase1-v2-internvl-spatial-holdout|ordinal|input_image') rows among relative_position rows excluding the 30-topic development set; ordinals serialized ascending

vstar_internvl_spatial_confirmation.purpose: second Phase-1 transfer set; opened under v3, then used only for v4 failure diagnosis
vstar_internvl_spatial_confirmation.selection_rule: next 20 rows under the original sha256('phase1-v2-internvl-spatial-holdout|ordinal|input_image') ordering after the first diagnostic 20; selected before running or reading these rows; ordinals serialized ascending

vstar_internvl_spatial_final_confirmatio.purpose: previously uninspected Phase-1 v4 final confirmation holdout
vstar_internvl_spatial_final_confirmatio.selection_rule: next 20 rows under the original sha256('phase1-v2-internvl-spatial-holdout|ordinal|input_image') ordering after the two opened transfer sets; selected before running or reading these rows; ordinals serialized ascending

hr-bench_4k_transfer.selection_rule: existing 12-topic source-grouped transfer subset; retained without reselection

treebench_holdout.selection_rule: next 12 lowest sha256('phase2-v3-treebench|ordinal|input_image') rows after treebench_dev; disjoint images; ordinals serialized ascending
